Shady third-party platforms are listing and reselling restaurant reservations without permission.

While they profit, Lowcountry restaurants deal with no-shows, lost revenue, and zero accountability.

When bots hijack reservation systems, the damage does not stop at the front door. Servers, bartenders, and kitchen staff all suffer from the lost income.

We introduced the SEAT Act to put Lowcountry restaurants back in control of their own tables. 

Lowcountry FIRST.

You put us here to fight for you.

Less screen time. More movement.

The Presidential Fitness Test is back.

This fall, schools across the country will bring back the Presidential Fitness Test using updated, age-appropriate standards measuring strength, endurance, speed, and agility while encouraging improvement and growth.

This is about America’s children getting stronger, more active, and building lifelong healthy habits.

Make America Healthy Again.
